communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I request records maintained by the U.S. Department of Labor's Employee Benefits Security Administration (EBSA) concerning complaints, investigations, and enforcement actions related to the forfeiture of employer contributions to defined contribution retirement plans, including 401(k) plans, when employees leave employment before completing a three-year cliff-vesting period.

For the period January 1, 2020, through October 22, 2026, I request:

Existing statistical reports, datasets, or other records documenting the number of complaints received concerning the forfeiture of unvested employer contributions because employees left employment before completing the applicable vesting period, particularly three-year cliff-vesting schedules.

Records documenting the number of investigations initiated, completed, or closed concerning alleged errors or violations involving vesting schedules, calculation of years of service, and forfeiture of employer contributions.

Records documenting the outcomes of these investigations, including findings of noncompliance, corrective actions, restoration of benefits, civil penalties, or other enforcement measures, where applicable.

Existing agency reports, analyses, guidance, or internal policy documents addressing recurring complaints or patterns involving employees losing employer contributions before reaching full vesting.

Any existing data or reports distinguishing complaints involving three-year cliff vesting from complaints involving graduated vesting schedules or other vesting arrangements.

I am seeking aggregate statistics and records that can be disclosed without personally identifying individual retirement plan participants. Where responsive records contain exempt information, I request that reasonably segregable, nonexempt portions be released.

If the agency does not maintain records in precisely these categories, I request any existing records or datasets that most closely correspond to the subject matter described above.

Please provide responsive records electronically where available. If fees are expected to exceed the applicable threshold, please notify me before proceeding.

Thank you for your assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lyneka Little
